name: Fujiwara no Sadakata
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 25); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 932.

poems.title: I hear thou art as modest as
poems.author: Fujiwara no Sadakata
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 25
poems.text:
I hear thou art as modest as
The little creeping spray
Upon Mount Ōsaka, which hides
Beneath the grass; then, pray,
Wander with me to-day.

poems.title: 25. 名にしおはば 逢坂山の さねかづら (Na ni shi owaba Osakayama no sanekazura)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Sadakata
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後撰集
poems.text:
名にしおはば 逢坂山の さねかづら
人にしられで くるよしもがな
